text: This report recommends that the name "Andy Masellis Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane in a block bounded by Dewhurst Boulevard, Strathmore Boulevard, Donlands Avenue and Danforth Avenue. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Andy Masellis Lane" for an existing public lane in a block bounded by Dewhurst Boulevard, Strathmore Boulevard, Donlands Avenue and Danforth Avenue.
